title: Amkor Technology (AMKR) Lands Nvidia Deal As Investors Ask If The Stock Is Already Priced In
title_zh: Amkor Technology (AMKR) 与 Nvidia 达成交易，投资者询问该股是否已定价
summary: Amkor Technology (AMKR) is back in focus after announcing a multi-year, $1.5b partnership with NVIDIA, including a sizeable prepayment aimed at expanding Amkor’s advanced semiconductor packaging and testing capacity in the U.S. See our latest analysis for Amkor Technology.
summary_zh: Amkor Technology (AMKR) 宣布与 NVIDIA 建立为期 1.5 亿美元的多年合作伙伴关系，其中包括一笔巨额预付款，旨在扩大 Amkor 在美国的先进半导体封装和测试能力，从而重新成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对 Amkor Technology 的最...

title: Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) Got Lucky While Micron’s The Real Deal, Says Jim Cramer
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，西部数据公司（纳斯达克股票代码：WDC）在美光的真正交易中很幸运
summary: Even though the shares have been among the top performers in the market, CNBC’s Jim Cramer still believes that Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) got lucky. The stock is up by 644% over the past year and by 173% year-to-date.
summary_zh: 尽管该股一直是市场表现最好的股票之一，但 CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 仍然认为西部数据公司（纳斯达克股票代码：WDC）很幸运。该股去年上涨了 644%，今年迄今上涨了 173%。

title: Kuwait signs $16 billion oil pipeline deal with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield
title_zh: 科威特与 Blackstone、KKR 和 Brookfield 签署价值 160 亿美元的石油管道协议
summary: Investing.com -- Kuwait Petroleum Corporation has signed a $16 billion lease and leaseback agreement covering its crude oil pipeline network with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield, Reuters reported.
summary_zh: 据路透社报道，科威特石油公司已与 Blackstone、KKR 和 Brookfield 签署了价值 160 亿美元的租赁和回租协议，涵盖其原油管道网络。

title: Salesforce (CRM) Lands $1.6 Billion VA Deal To Power Veteran Care
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 与 VA 达成 16 亿美元交易，为退伍军人护理提供支持
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has secured a US$1.6 billion, three-year contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The Missionforce platform will be used to modernize care and service delivery for more than 17 million veterans.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）已与美国退伍军人事务部签订了一份价值 16 亿美元、为期三年的合同。 Missionforce 平台将用于为超过 1700 万退伍军人提供现代化的护理和服务。

title: Oracle Stock Reverses Lower Despite Pentagon Software Deal
title_zh: 尽管有五角大楼软件交易，甲骨文股价仍下跌
summary: Oracle stock initially climbed after news of a software deal with the Pentagon. But the gains didn't hold.
summary_zh: 在与五角大楼达成软件交易的消息传出后，甲骨文股价最初上涨。但收益并没有保持。
